title: European UAV and Counter-UAS Hubs Research
scope: EU27 + United Kingdom, Norway, Switzerland, Ukraine and Türkiye

methodology.unit: Research records include organisations, site records, programmes, candidates and planned developments. This is not a count of independent operational hubs.
methodology.inclusion: A documented UAV research, testing, training, acceleration or ecosystem function; broad defence and aviation leads are kept separately when UAV qualification remains unresolved.
methodology.evidence: Public primary/operator, government, university or institutional sources. Search excerpts and selected full pages were inspected; not every page was read in full.
methodology.map_candidate: Documented relevant function and a public named locality with approximate centroid. This is a minimum research threshold, not completed editorial approval or operational certification.
methodology.coordinates: Approximate manually selected place centroids, generally rounded to two decimal places; never runway, flight-volume or precise office geometry.
methodology.status: Documented means an official source describes the function. It does not prove current booking availability, commissioning of every planned capability, or open commercial access.
methodology.recency: Review date is retrieval date, not date of establishment or confirmation of current services. Older evidence is labelled where it affects eligibility.
methodology.completeness: A broad first-wave country review, not exhaustive. NATO test-centre affiliation alone is not proof of UAV/C-UAS scope.
methodology.language: All authored public copy is English. Original source titles retain source-language spelling as evidence metadata.
methodology.publication: Research staging only. No website, database or publication eligibility has been changed.
